sources.title: [2604.22363] LeHome: A Simulation Environment for Deformable Object ...
sources.snippet: We introduce LeHome, a comprehensive simulation environment designed for deformable object manipulation in household scenarios. LeHome covers a wide spectrum of deformable objects, such as garments and food items, offering high-fidelity dynamics and realistic interactions that existing simulators struggle to simulate accurately.
